resources.string: Voice input
Speak through your car\'s hands-free microphone after pressing a button. Not finished yet: for now this only tests the microphone.
Voice input

Listens through your car\'s hands-free microphone, the one calls use, only after you press a voice button, and stops when you finish speaking. Needs the Microphone permission, which is asked for when you turn this on. The phone\'s own microphone is never used: if the car\'s microphone is not connected, voice input says so and does not listen. Speech will be turned into text on the phone, with a speech model file you supply; nothing uses the network. Audio is held in memory only until it is turned into text, and is never saved or reported. Off, the app holds no microphone.
Car microphone connected.
Test car microphone
Stop listening

Listens once through the car\'s hands-free microphone, as a voice button press will. Say a sentence after tapping; it stops when you pause, or tap Stop listening. It then shows how long it heard you and how loud, and how long the car took to open its microphone. Music pauses while it listens and should come back afterwards. Nothing is played back, saved or reported apart from those numbers.
